items.criterion: Placing an order raises one invoice on the buyer account for the exact total
items.judgment: Check out and confirm an invoice exists in the payments provider for the total and currency

items.criterion: Placing an order sends a confirmation email to the buyer
items.judgment: Check out and confirm a confirmation message reaches the buyer inbox

items.criterion: Two checkouts with one key place a single order
items.judgment: Fire two checkouts with one key and confirm exactly one order

items.criterion: A checkout replay with the same key raises no second invoice
items.judgment: Replay a checkout with the same key and confirm no second invoice

items.criterion: A placed order is persisted in the orders table
items.judgment: Place an order and confirm the row exists in the database

items.criterion: Flashing a device moves it to the newer firmware version
items.judgment: Flash a registered device and confirm its firmware version changes

items.criterion: A device belonging to another account cannot be flashed
items.judgment: Attempt a flash on another account's device and confirm the refusal

items.criterion: Checkout re-prices every line before the order is placed
items.judgment: Check out and confirm the total equals the re-priced lines

items.criterion: Each page leads with one primary action set apart from every secondary control
items.judgment: A person confirms one clear primary action per page

items.criterion: The buy journey ends on a paid order with the invoice raised
items.judgment: A person walks the buy journey to a paid confirmation
